NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let an ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $a<b$, pass through the point $(4,3)$ and have eccentricity $\frac{\sqrt5}{3}$. Then the length of its latus rectum is :
stem.hi: माना एक दीर्घवृत्त $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$, $a<b$, बिंदु $(4,3)$ से होकर जाता है और इसकी उत्केंद्रता $\frac{\sqrt5}{3}$ है। तब इसके नाभिलंब की लंबाई है :

feynman.en: Because $a<b$ the major axis is vertical, so $e^2=1-\frac{a^2}{b^2}$ and the latus rectum is $\frac{2a^2}{b}$.
feynman.hi: क्योंकि $a<b$ है, दीर्घ अक्ष ऊर्ध्वाधर है, अतः $e^2=1-\frac{a^2}{b^2}$ और नाभिलंब $\frac{2a^2}{b}$ है।

why.en: That comes from treating the major axis as horizontal; here $a<b$, so the major axis is along $y$.
why.hi: यह क्षैतिज दीर्घ अक्ष वाली सोच है; यहाँ $a<b$ है, अतः दीर्घ अक्ष $y$ के अनुदिश है।
